title: Convenient access to your own password file
description: Search and autofill work for entries in a compatible format.

blocks.text: The owner of their own file wants to use it on a phone without copying data across by hand all the time.

quote.text: The autofill feature is clunky and spotty at best. Sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn’t. Biggest complaint, otherwise it’s a decent app.

blocks.text: Link choosing the account, filling the form and updating the entry. Show the format compatibility and the supported setup in advance.
The work has to be tested on real sign-in forms. Reading the database does not yet guarantee autofill in every app or support for passkeys.
